notes: «زاد معاذ عن شعبة ...» names a different teacher (معاذ) and a different wording for the same saying: a variant group, never a route of the main isnad.
«قال رجل من القوم» is the speaker inside the matn, not a link.
The Companion معاذا is a link, not only a scene figure: «عن عمرو بن ميمون، أن معاذا» gives him as Amr's source (rule 5).
